versions.changelog:
Initial release of qizheng-brand-marketing v1.0.0:

- Integrates Ogilvy, BBDO, Saatchi & Saatchi, Y&R practical branding methodologies.
- Introduces 七政·OASIS simulation system for viral prediction and crisis management.
- Provides a 5-step end-to-end brand marketing process with detailed frameworks and outputs.
- Includes KOC (Key Opinion Customer) segmentation and pre-set execution packages.
- Offers standardized diagnostic questionnaire and crisis response toolkit.
- Delivers rapid brand marketing execution with clear deliverables and calling instructions.
